comment: Golden outputs of the C++ props placement (PROPS_LAYERS.md 5 C3 / T2). Paths are relative to this folder. For each case: parse 'input', re-roll 'layer' with 'seed' (PropsPlacementRules::RerollLayer) on 'layout' with 'balance', write the whole props file with the canonical writer (LevelPropsFile::Write: tab indent, LF, trailing newline) = 'output' byte for byte. 'derived_from': the input is that case's output with indices 'lock' locked, 'delete' deleted (override with pos), 'move' moved by move_by_cm (override) and 'hand' turned into a hand add (removed from the layer, override add 'hand_<layer>_0' at its pos). Regenerate: set CODEX_PROPS_GOLDEN_WRITE=1 and run CodexTactics.LevelGen.Props.Placement.Golden.
